meta.purpose: Imports one already-redacted hourly aggregate and its four source provenance records.

nodes.name: Persist hourly GDELT context

parameters.query: =INSERT INTO forex.source_registry (source_id, contract_version, owner, license, cost_model, api_version, endpoint_allowlist, rate_limit, retention_rule, historical_depth, revision_support, timezone_policy, outage_policy, approval_status, secrets_reference, provenance_note) VALUES ('gdelt-sentiment-prototype', 'forex.gdelt-context.v1', 'GDELT Project', 'Derived aggregates only; see source qualification', 'FREE_PUBLIC', 'GDELT 2.0 GKG', '[\"https://data.gdeltproject.org/gdeltv2/\"]'::jsonb, 'four archives per bounded hour', 'No article text; retain aggregates and provenance only', 'historical GKG archive', 'source filename and SHA-256 retained', 'UTC-normalised', 'record failure in n8n execution and retry that hour', 'PENDING_QUALIFICATION', 'NONE', 'Experimental EUR/USD context aggregate; not a trading signal') ON CONFLICT (source_id) DO UPDATE SET contract_version=EXCLUDED.contract_version, provenance_note=EXCLUDED.provenance_note; WITH source_rows AS (SELECT * FROM jsonb_to_recordset('{{ JSON.stringify($json.source_records) }}'::jsonb) AS x(observation_id text, source_revision text, observed_at_utc timestamptz, available_at_utc timestamptz, payload_sha256 text, payload_path text)) INSERT INTO forex.raw_observation (observation_id, contract_version, source_id, source_revision, observed_at_utc, available_at_utc, retrieved_at_utc, timezone, payload_sha256, payload_path, redacted) SELECT observation_id, 'forex.gdelt-context.v1', 'gdelt-sentiment-prototype', source_revision, observed_at_utc, available_at_utc, '{{ $json.retrieved_at_utc }}', 'UTC', payload_sha256, payload_path, true FROM source_rows ON CONFLICT (observation_id) DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO forex.raw_observation (observation_id, contract_version, source_id, source_revision, observed_at_utc, available_at_utc, retrieved_at_utc, timezone, payload_sha256, payload_path, redacted) VALUES ('{{ $json.hour_observation_id }}', 'forex.gdelt-context.v1', 'gdelt-sentiment-prototype', '{{ $json.hour_start_utc }}-4x15m', '{{ $json.hour_start_utc }}', '{{ new Date(new Date($json.hour_start_utc).getTime() + 3600000).toISOString() }}', '{{ $json.retrieved_at_utc }}', 'UTC', '{{ $json.aggregate_sha256 }}', 'n8n://gdelt/h1/{{ $json.hour_start_utc }}', true) ON CONFLICT (observation_id) DO NOTHING; INSERT INTO forex.gdelt_h1_aggregate (aggregate_id, observation_id, bucket_time_utc, available_at_utc, article_count, mean_tone, query_definition_version, uncertainty_label) VALUES ('{{ $json.hour_observation_id }}', '{{ $json.hour_observation_id }}', '{{ $json.hour_start_utc }}', '{{ new Date(new Date($json.hour_start_utc).getTime() + 3600000).toISOString() }}', {{ $json.article_count }}, {{ $json.mean_tone }}, '{{ $json.query_definition_version }}', '{{ $json.uncertainty_label }}') ON CONFLICT (observation_id, bucket_time_utc) DO UPDATE SET article_count=EXCLUDED.article_count, mean_tone=EXCLUDED.mean_tone, available_at_utc=EXCLUDED.available_at_utc;

nodes.notes: Fixed schema-only import. No arbitrary SQL, raw text, order, or execution surface.

parameters.jsCode: return [{ json: { result: 'FOREX_M11_N8N_HOURLY_IMPORT_OK', bucket_time_utc: $('Aggregate import input').first().json.hour_start_utc, source_archives: 4 } }];
